blocks.text: IntersectionObserver tells your code when an element crosses a visibility boundary. It avoids doing a manual scroll check on every scroll event.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: When the note enters the viewport, the message is logged once and the observer stops watching it.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: An intersection is not proof that a person read the content. It only reports a geometric visibility condition.
